properties.description: Dangerously hot conditions with heat index values up to 112 expected. Heat illnesses increase significantly during extreme heat events.
properties.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued September 7 at 2:15PM CDT until September 8 at 8:00PM CDT by NWS Tulsa OK
properties.instruction: Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
